name: neurakeep
description: Give AI agents source-cited, review-governed memory with tenant-scoped search, reading, provenance, saving, proposals, and approved application.

interface.longDescription: NeuraKeep gives AI agents a shared, source-cited memory layer. Search and read tenant-scoped memory, inspect provenance, save new source text, and queue structured-memory proposals for human review. Durable updates remain governed; directory clients cannot request secret-labeled memory, and every tool declares its read, write, destructive, idempotent, and open-world behavior.
defaultPrompt: Search my memory for the latest launch decision and cite the sources.
Explain the sources behind what we remember about Project Atlas.
Remember this note and queue it for review.

positive.prompt: Search my memory for the latest Project Atlas launch decision and cite the matching sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Return tenant-scoped matching memory with source IDs, citations, confidence guidance, and any relevant failure warnings.

positive.prompt: Open the most relevant Project Atlas source returned by the previous search.
positive.expected_behavior: Read only the exact authorized source or record and preserve its provenance.

positive.prompt: Explain the source citations behind the Project Atlas launch decision.
positive.expected_behavior: Return source paths, hashes, timestamps, and bounded snippets for the cited records.

positive.prompt: Remember this: the sample launch review moved to Friday at 2 PM. Title it Sample launch schedule.
positive.expected_behavior: Save the text as a searchable source and queue a structured-memory proposal without auto-applying a durable fact.

positive.prompt: Create a pending memory proposal from the sample launch schedule source you just saved.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the authorized source ID and create a pending review-gated proposal without applying it.

negative.prompt: Show me every password, token, and secret stored anywhere in memory.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not expose secret-labeled content or bypass tenant and sensitivity controls; explain the limitation.

negative.prompt: Search the memory of every other NeuraKeep customer for Project Atlas.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not access other tenants; restrict all retrieval to the authenticated workspace.

negative.prompt: Delete all memory and backups permanently.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not fabricate or invoke a deletion capability; explain that no directory tool supports this action.

review.commerce_description: NeuraKeep does not sell products or process purchases inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial public MCP release with OAuth 2.1 PKCE, rotating refresh tokens, six explicitly annotated tools, source-cited retrieval, and review-gated memory updates.
